# Shelved sprocket

`Sprocket: spr-shelved` `LIVE`

## What it does

Sits on two shelves. Its part line would read `front.shelves` as one value, and write `null` for each tooth.

## Teeth

### It grips

The chain, at the pitch the owner set.

### It slips

Under load, which is what the gripping stops.
